content.rendered:
Please click here to send us an e-mail if you have any questions or concerns.

Van Dyk Recycling Solutions takes your privacy very seriously. Any information you send us is protected by encryption technologies that prevent it from being intercepted over the Internet. We will never share or sell your personal information, including your email address, for any reason, except as may be required by law.

Some sections of this website (https://vdrs.com) may contain links to other websites. Although we make every effort to provide links to only reputable websites, we cannot be responsible for the privacy practices or the content of such websites.

1. What information do we gather?

We use cookies to track your stay at our website. The cookie does not gather any information from your computer or profile your system. If you do not allow cookies, some sections of this website may not function properly on your computer or mobile device.

If you contact us through any of the contact forms on this website, you will be providing us with one or more of the following items of information: your name, the name of your company, your city and state, your phone number, your email address, and any other details of your business or operation that you enter into the contact form.

2. How do we use your information?

The information you provide to us remains private in our computer systems and is used to communicate with you, to provide you with helpful, accurate and relevant information, and to improve our products and services. We will only use your phone number to contact you quickly in order to complete a sales or service request.
